import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a scatter plot with linear regression line
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='BMI Category', style='Sleep Disorder', palette='Set2', ax=ax)

# Add a regression line
sns.regplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', scatter=False, ax=ax, color='gray', line_kws={'linewidth':1})

# Add labels and title
ax.set_title('Relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)

# Add legend
ax.legend(title='BMI Category / Sleep Disorder', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
